  CITY COUNCIL MINUTES

  DECEMBER 19, 2023

  A special meeting of the Santa Monica City Council was called to order by Mayor Brock at 4:37 p.m., on
  Tuesday, December 19, 2023, at City Council Chambers, 1685 Main Street, Santa Monica, CA and at Hotel
  Riu Plaza Guadalajara, Av. Adolfo López Mateos Sur 830, Chapalita, 44500, Guadalajara, Jalisco, Mexico.

  Mayor Pro Tem Lana Negrete
